message.content: LiHua expresses curiosity about the TV series "The Rings of Power," which is connected to J.R.R. Tolkien's literary epic "The Lord of the Rings." This interest is evident in a conversation where they discuss the rich background and lore that could potentially enhance the understanding and appreciation of "The Rings of Power." LiHua is particularly intrigued by the way the series explores the characters' stories, indicating a desire to delve deeper into the narrative that expands upon Tolkien's universe. This show is a prequel to "The Lord of the Rings" film trilogy, offering fans of the books and movies an opportunity to see the foundations and events leading up to the events in the original series.
